Short answer: we can support both flows, but the approvals differ. Notes below to include in our response to Clearwater: 

1) Card-on-file (default hosted flow)
- No credit checks, immediate activation, monthly auto-charge; good for quick trials and fast onboarding.
- We can provide the CSV line items upon request; cost center mapping handled via cost-center tags in invoice metadata.

2) Monthly invoice with net terms (sales/finance path)
- Net30 is our baseline for most customers; Net45 is possible as an exception but requires: signed SOW / contract, customer PO for the first month, and a standard credit check (we use a third-party provider).
- For Net45 we typically require either: a rolling monthly minimum or a revenue commit (or a short initial deposit) — if they prefer no commit we ask for manager approval and escalate toRevenue Ops.

3) Deliverables we should attach: rate card, sample invoice CSV, W-9, and SOC2 summary. I attached the rate card and a sample invoice CSV to this thread.

Recommendation to offer Clearwater: 
- Option A: Card on file + consolidated monthly PDF/CSV (fastest path).
- Option B: Net30 invoice with immediate activation; if they insist on Net45, offer Net45 conditional on signed SOW + PO + a one-time initial month prepay OR a 45-day trial period with credit check.

If they push hard on Net45 without commit, I'm happy to escalate for a one-off for strategic accounts (deal CW-983) but want approval from RevOps.

Ben
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Hi Sofia — thanks for the clear ask. Short options below so your AP team can pick the simplest path: 

1) Card on file (recommended for fastest activation)
- We tokenize card data; monthly auto charge; we will send a consolidated PDF + CSV with line items mapped to cost centers. No PO required.

2) Monthly invoice (standard)
- Net30 standard. We can accept net45 as an exception if Clearwater: provides a signed SOW, issues a PO for the first month, and completes our standard credit check. If accepted, billing will be consolidated per month and we will include cost-center CSV mapping.

3) Hybrid fallback
- Accept PO + net45 but require card-on-file as a fallback if payment is late for >60 days (we can add simple fallback language in the SOW).

Attachments included: Redwood_rate_card_hosted_api_Q4_2026.pdf, sample-monthly-invoice-Redwood.csv, W-9 and SOC2 one-pager.

Can you confirm AP contact (name/email) and whether Clearwater prefers net45 with PO + credit check or card-on-file? If you want, Ben can pick up negotiation on the commercial terms (commit / discount) after AP confirms flow.
